$comment: Copy to <project>/.claude/crew.json. Every key is optional. This is a plausible single-package layout (src/<module>/..., TypeScript); adapt the paths and patterns to your project. Keys named $comment are ignored.

specFirst.$comment: Before an existing production file under a root is edited, a test file must already be touched under the same module: modified, staged, untracked, or committed ahead of origin/<baseBranch>. Without a specFirst block the hook does nothing. ruleFile (optional) names a project file that explains the rule, for example docs/testing.md. For a flat folder (src/slugify.js with tests in test/), set moduleDepth to 0 and testRoots to ['test'] on the root.

roots.$comment: src/<module>/...: the first directory under the root is the module. src/shared and src/common are cross-cutting: a test anywhere under src satisfies them.
